codex_fields.name: Weaponized Incompetence
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The task lands permanently on one person, along with the work of noticing it, asking about it, and eventually giving up on asking. Raising it also makes them sound as if they are complaining about help they were offered.

codex_fields.name: Strategic Apathy
codex_fields.why_this_matters: One person makes every decision alone and then carries the criticism for whichever way it went. Over time, deciding stops feeling like having a say and starts feeling like exposure.

codex_fields.name: Reverse Psychology
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target's own resistance is what does the deciding, so a choice that felt like their own defiance may not have been theirs at all.

codex_fields.name: Malicious Compliance
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target absorbs the failure with no clear grievance available to them: the instruction was followed, so there is nothing they can point at without sounding unreasonable.

codex_fields.name: Moral Licensing
codex_fields.why_this_matters: A specific, current complaint goes unanswered because the conversation turns into a referendum on someone's overall goodness, which the target cannot win and did not raise.

codex_fields.name: Strategic Self-Deprecation / Performed Humility
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target arrives with a concern and leaves having provided reassurance. The thing they came to say never gets said, and they often feel unkind for having wanted to say it.

codex_fields.name: Priming / Narrative Seeding
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target reads an event through a lens they never chose, and mistakes a supplied conclusion for their own judgement. The frame is hardest to question precisely because it arrived before the evidence did.

codex_fields.name: Ambiguity as Weapon
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target can feel the exclusion but cannot point to it. Naming it out loud sounds paranoid, and staying quiet means carrying the doubt alone.

codex_fields.name: Push-Pull
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target organises their attention around a temperature they cannot predict, and tends to read each cold spell as something they must have caused.

codex_fields.name: Intermittent Reinforcement
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Effort keeps rising as the returns fall. The rarity of the good moments is exactly what makes them feel worth waiting for, so the pattern is self-sustaining.

codex_fields.name: Breadcrumbing
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target stays available for a relationship that never arrives, holding a place open on the strength of contact that costs almost nothing to send.

codex_fields.name: Trauma Bonding
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Relief and harm come from the same source, so the target's strongest sense of closeness arrives directly after the worst treatment — and then becomes a reason to stay.

codex_fields.name: Relief Bait
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Each round of kindness resets what the target can tolerate, so the baseline of acceptable treatment moves downward without them noticing it move.

codex_fields.name: Withholding
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Ordinary things — an answer, an acknowledgement, basic warmth — turn into rewards, and the target starts negotiating for what was previously free. Because nothing visible happened, there is nothing to describe to anyone else.

codex_fields.name: Dr. Jekyll/Mr. Hyde
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target has no witnesses. The version other people know makes their account of the other version sound implausible, including to themselves.

codex_fields.name: Ambient Abuse
codex_fields.why_this_matters: There is nothing to quote, so the exhaustion has no justification the target can offer to anyone, themselves included. They stay braced without being able to say what for.

codex_fields.name: Ghosting-Orbiting Cycle
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target is neither in contact nor free of it. Attention keeps arriving with no reply attached, which keeps hope alive at precisely the point it was starting to fade.

codex_fields.name: Stonewalling
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Every issue stays permanently open. The target cannot resolve it, cannot drop it, and cannot even find out when it might be discussed.

codex_fields.name: Sealioning
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target's energy goes into sourcing and proving rather than into being heard, and the point they were trying to make is eventually abandoned for reasons of stamina.

codex_fields.name: Idealize-Devalue-Discard Cycle
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target measures the ending against the extraordinary beginning and concludes that they must have caused the decline — which is also the conclusion that keeps them trying to earn the beginning back.

codex_fields.name: Extinction Bursts
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The first boundary that actually works is the one that costs the most, which teaches the target that holding a limit makes things worse rather than better.

codex_fields.name: Competitive Victimhood
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target's own pain never gets a hearing, and rather than enter a contest they cannot win, they stop raising things at all.

codex_fields.name: Ambient Sexual Threat
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target reorganises their movements, schedule and attention around one person while holding nothing concrete enough to report, or even to explain to a friend.

codex_fields.name: "Polite Hostile" Environments
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Nothing that happens is documentable, so whoever spoke up carries the cost alone with no case to make. Everyone watching learns that silence is the sensible option.

codex_fields.name: Self-Gaslighting Induction
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The doubting continues with nobody present to do it. The target discounts things they clearly remember and edits their own account before anyone has even challenged it.

codex_fields.name: Fawning
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Safety is bought with the target's own position: they apologise for things done to them, and lose track of what they actually think while they are still saying it.

codex_fields.name: Self-Abandonment
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target can say what would keep the peace far more readily than what they want, and their own limits stop being information they are willing to act on.

codex_fields.name: Internalized Conditioning
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The rules keep running in the other person's absence, so distance — even ending the relationship — no longer brings the relief the target expected it to.

codex_fields.name: Silence Installation
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The problems most in need of raising become the ones the target physically cannot raise, so they go unaddressed indefinitely and quietly grow.

codex_fields.name: Approval Addiction Cultivation
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target's sense of how they are doing is outsourced to someone else's mood, and their own view of a thing arrives too late to count for much.

codex_fields.name: Parentification
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target treats their own needs as an imposition, and the growing-up that was postponed to keep an adult afloat does not happen later on its own.

codex_fields.name: Process Exhaustion
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target loses to depletion rather than to a decision, and the outcome is recorded as voluntary — they withdrew, they did not pursue it, they stopped replying.

codex_fields.name: HR Shielding
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The person who reported the harm absorbs the disruption while the situation they reported continues, and everyone else in the organisation learns what reporting costs.

codex_fields.name: Pseudo-Consultation
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target spends real effort and real candour on input that could never have changed anything, and the decision is afterwards described as one they helped make.

codex_fields.name: Tokenism
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target's presence is used as the answer to the criticism they were brought in to voice, and objecting to that makes them look ungrateful for the seat.

codex_fields.name: Individualization of Systemic Issues
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target adds self-improvement to an already unsustainable load, and concludes that the shortfall is in their own resilience rather than in the conditions.

codex_fields.name: Diffusion of Responsibility
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The harm is real and nobody is answerable for it, so the target has nowhere to take it, no one to ask for repair, and no way to stop it recurring.

codex_fields.name: Deepfakes
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target is left disproving something that never happened, to people who have already seen it — and denial is exactly what a guilty person would also say.

codex_fields.name: AI Voice Cloning
codex_fields.why_this_matters: A voice the target has trusted their whole life stops being evidence of anything, and verifying every unexpected call through a second channel becomes a permanent tax on ordinary contact.

codex_fields.name: Doxxing
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Risk moves offline and out of the target's hands: their home, workplace and family become reachable by strangers who have no relationship to the original dispute, and the exposure cannot be reversed.

codex_fields.name: Sock Puppets
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target argues against what looks like a consensus and concludes they are the outlier, when the numbers on the other side were never real.

codex_fields.name: Coordinated Reporting
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target loses their account, their reach, or their income through a system built to protect people, and there is no realistic appeal against a decision that was made on volume.

codex_fields.name: Credential-Costuming
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target defers to standing that is not there, and the questions they would otherwise have asked start to feel out of place. Decisions then rest on the appearance of expertise rather than on anything that was tested.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: An unfamiliar credential is not a false one — plenty of genuine titles mean nothing outside their field, and modest people describe real experience in ways that happen to sound grand. A claim you cannot place is something to check, not a finding in itself.

codex_fields.name: Identity Performances
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Trust is extended to a version of someone that does not exist, so the target's read on the relationship rests on facts that were supplied to them rather than observed.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Everyone presents differently in different rooms, and someone rebuilding or still working out who they are is changing rather than fabricating. The question is whether specific claims hold up under a reasonable follow-up, not whether the person seems unlike themselves at work.

codex_fields.name: Social Engineering
codex_fields.why_this_matters: What gets used is the target's ordinary decency — helpfulness, deference to apparent authority, reluctance to make a fuss — so the loss afterwards feels like a personal failing rather than something done to them.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Genuinely urgent legitimate requests exist, and real IT or security staff follow processes that most people have never met before. Checking back through a channel you already trust costs an honest request nothing, which is why it is the cheap test here rather than suspicion of the person.
codex_fields.note: This entry sits closer to fraud than to relational manipulation, so the disconfirming case is framed around verification rather than around pattern-over-instance.

codex_fields.name: Performative Allyship / False Solidarity
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Trust is given on the strength of stated values, and the gap only becomes visible at the moment support would have cost something — which is usually the moment the target most needed it.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Many people are further along in their stated values than in their practice and are genuinely, if unevenly, catching up. Quiet support that is never announced anywhere is the reverse of this pattern, not a mild version of it.

codex_fields.name: Premature Exclusivity
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target commits before they hold the information the decision needed, and by the time it arrives they have already given up the alternatives they would have weighed it against.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Some people simply prefer clarity early, and two people can both want to close things down quickly and be delighted about it; pacing norms differ by culture and by person. What separates the two is whether hesitation is allowed to stand without a penalty.

codex_fields.name: Confirmation Bias Exploitation
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target's own hopefulness becomes the thing that keeps them in place, and the pattern stays invisible to the one person best placed to see it.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Most relationships genuinely are mostly good, and holding on to the good parts is not denial. The tendency only becomes something that can be worked on when the good stretches reliably arrive straight after harm rather than independently of it.

codex_fields.name: Halo Effect Exploitation
codex_fields.why_this_matters: A concern gets weighed against someone's reputation rather than against the evidence for it, and the target usually learns not to raise it before anyone else has even heard it.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Being excellent at one thing does sometimes go with being decent generally, and a real track record legitimately earns some benefit of the doubt. It goes wrong when an achievement is offered as the answer to a concern that has nothing to do with it.

codex_fields.name: Obligation Contracts
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target is held to a debt they never agreed, and asking what they actually signed up for is treated as evidence of disloyalty rather than as a fair question.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Long relationships do build genuine mutual obligations that both people would describe the same way if asked separately, and someone can be honestly hurt that an assumed closeness was not there. This describes a debt only one party has ever stated the terms of.

codex_fields.name: Covert Contracts
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target is judged against a standard they had no access to, so effort never produces safety — there is always another rule they have not been told.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Some expectations are shared widely enough that most people would recognise them unstated, and people often believe in good faith that something was mutual. Someone who adjusts readily once told the rule was never communicated is having a miscommunication, not enforcing one.

codex_fields.name: Financial Dependence by Design
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Leaving becomes a question of survival rather than of judgement, so whatever the target concludes about the relationship, the conclusion cannot change anything.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Plenty of households divide earning and caring by genuine agreement, and caregiving, illness or a poor job market limit independence without anyone arranging it. The thing to look at is what happens when the dependent person takes a step toward independence.

codex_fields.name: Platform Migration
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target loses the record, so any later dispute about what was said becomes their word against someone else's, with the whole burden of remembering exactly falling on them.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Wanting to talk difficult things through by voice is a common and reasonable preference, and there are real privacy reasons to avoid particular apps. What distinguishes this is whether the preference covers everything or only what might later be quoted back.

codex_fields.name: Benching
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target's availability is preserved while their status stays undefined, so they keep a place open for something with no timeline and turn down things that had one.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Early connections genuinely are undefined for a while, people are honestly busy, and openly casual arrangements both parties accept are their own thing. What is missing here is honesty about where things stand, not intensity.

codex_fields.name: "Sacred Duty" Manipulation
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Refusal stops being a preference and becomes a moral failure, so the target cannot decline without feeling they have done something wrong — and often cannot appeal to anyone inside their own community.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Faith, ancestry and family duty are real values that millions of people hold and invoke sincerely, and someone speaking from conviction about their own obligations is not doing this. Watch whether the sacred framing shows up for every request or only for the ones that happen to suit the speaker.
codex_fields.note: Written to avoid implying that religious or ancestral obligation is itself suspect; the disconfirming case carries most of that weight.

codex_fields.name: Shame-as-Governance Disguised as Advice
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target comes away smaller rather than better equipped, and objection is pre-answered: it was only ever offered as help.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Real feedback is often unwelcome in the moment, and delivery can be clumsy without being an attack. The usable test is what you are left holding afterwards — something to do, or only something to feel.

codex_fields.name: PIP Weaponization
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target is set a target they cannot hit while the record for their exit is being assembled, and defending themselves means arguing against a document that already exists.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Genuine performance problems are real, and a formal plan with clear goals, actual support and honest timelines is how they are meant to be handled. What matters is the timing relative to a complaint or a protected absence, and whether the goals hold still once progress starts.

codex_fields.name: Credit Laundering
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target watches their own work succeed without them and cannot name a moment at which it was taken, which makes raising it sound like sour grapes even to themselves.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Ideas genuinely improve as they pass through people, large workplaces diffuse information with nobody steering it, and two people do sometimes arrive at the same thought separately. The signal is attribution disappearing along the way, not the idea travelling.

codex_fields.name: The "Good Woman Program"
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The same conduct costs the target more than it costs other people — a proportionate no draws a penalty — and over time the discomfort with taking up space is experienced as a personal trait rather than a learned response to that penalty.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Kindness and consideration are values many people genuinely hold for themselves, and some people are accommodating by temperament with nothing imposed about it. What is being described is an uneven cost attached to the same conduct, not the conduct itself.
codex_fields.note: Broad cultural pattern rather than a discrete exchange, so the disconfirming case had to separate personal temperament from an unevenly applied social cost; a reviewer may want to tighten this.

codex_fields.name: Objectification
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target's worth rises and falls with their usefulness, so the parts of them that are not useful go unwitnessed — and attention withdrawing feels like something they failed to supply.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Some relationships are frankly transactional and both people know it, and valuing a particular skill is not a reduction of the person who has it. Ask whether anything about them registers at the moments when the useful part is not needed.

codex_fields.name: Dehumanization
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Decisions get made about the target in language that has no slot for their perspective, so there is no point in the process at which their own account could plausibly be asked for.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Formal, clinical and bureaucratic language exists for good reasons and is applied to everybody in some settings, and professional detachment in triage is not contempt. Look for whether the reductive framing is used selectively for one person.

codex_fields.name: Overcorrection Demands
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Repair stops being achievable and becomes a performance of submission, and the target learns that small mistakes carry costs they cannot predict in advance.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: What looked minor sometimes turns out to have caused more damage than it first appeared, and expectations around apology vary a great deal between families and cultures. The revealing moment is what happens when the disproportion is named out loud.

codex_fields.name: Toxic Positivity / Weaponized Optimism
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target's dissatisfaction becomes the thing that needs fixing, so whatever caused it goes unexamined and saying so again costs them standing in the room.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Encouragement that arrives alongside real acknowledgement of the difficulty is a different thing, and people who are optimistic by temperament share that outlook without requiring anyone to match it. Perspective offered once about a genuinely small setback, and not insisted on, is ordinary.

codex_fields.name: Frame Assassination
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target arrives with a concern about an action and leaves defending their own stability. The original point is not refused, which is why it is so hard to notice that it was never answered.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Conversations drift, and redirecting one collaboratively is ordinary; someone can also raise a real worry about your wellbeing without meaning to displace what you said. The test is whether the original topic can be returned to at all.

codex_fields.name: Credibility Theft
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target's account is discounted before they give it, so whatever they later report lands on people who have already been prepared not to believe it — and they usually never learn why.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: A documented record of inaccuracy reasonably does affect how much weight an account carries, and doubting one particular claim is not a campaign. The separation is between doubt about a claim and doubt installed in advance about the person.

codex_fields.name: Projection
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target spends the conversation defending themselves against the thing being done to them, which makes the actual source of the harm very hard to see, let alone describe to anyone else.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: An accusation can be accurate even when it also describes the accuser, and in most conflicts both people contribute some of the same behaviour. Someone naming a pattern they share, and owning their half of it, is doing the opposite of this.

codex_fields.name: Authority Hijack
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target ends up arguing the case for their own feelings, and simply being taken at their word stops being available to them.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: People who know you well sometimes offer a reading you had not considered, and in therapy that questioning is invited rather than imposed; a clarifying question is not a counter-claim. The difference is whether your own account is still allowed to be the last word on it.

codex_fields.name: Accountability Evasion via Diagnosis
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The complaint is never answered — it is converted into a symptom, and the target is sent to seek treatment for a reaction to someone else's conduct.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: A real condition can genuinely be part of the picture, and someone qualified raising it with care is doing their job. The question is whether the original report ever gets answered by anybody, or whether the diagnosis is where the matter ends.

codex_fields.name: Identity Diminishment via Pathologizing
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Self-protection gets reclassified as a symptom, so the target's boundaries cost them credibility and any pushback is read as further evidence of the alleged problem.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: A trusted person can gently name a real escalation out of genuine care, and a diagnosis someone has disclosed themselves can be referred to supportively. What is described here is a boundary answered with a label instead of a response.

codex_fields.name: Pseudo-Insight as Shutdown
codex_fields.why_this_matters: A specific, checkable complaint is converted into something unfalsifiable about the target's inner life, which closes the conversation without anything being resolved or even disputed.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: "You're projecting" is sometimes accurate, and in a therapy room that kind of exploration is the agreed purpose of being there. The marker is a psychological reading offered as the whole reply to a concrete complaint.

codex_fields.name: Spiritual Bypassing
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target's anger is judged as a spiritual shortcoming and forgiveness is asked for before anything has been acknowledged, so the harm is closed off without ever having been repaired.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Many people hold these beliefs sincerely and apply them first to their own lives, and spiritual perspective offered alongside a real acknowledgement of what happened is not this. It is the ordering that matters: letting go requested before anything is admitted.

codex_fields.name: Burden of Proof Shifting
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target has to build a case for ordinary treatment, and the work of proving becomes the price of asking — a price most people eventually decline to keep paying.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Some disputes really do turn on evidence, and formal settings apply the same evidentiary standard to everybody in them. The flag here is proof demanded for a boundary or for a described experience, rather than for a contested fact.

codex_fields.name: Paltering
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target is misled by statements that are all individually true, and when they object they are told, correctly, that nothing false was said — so they end up doubting their own reasonable inference rather than the account.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Careful, precise people answer exactly what was asked without steering anyone anywhere, and someone can answer honestly with an incomplete picture because that is all they had. There are also things people are legitimately entitled not to disclose at all.

codex_fields.name: Gish Gallop
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target loses on throughput rather than on substance, and the fact that they could not answer everything gets treated as evidence that they could not answer anything.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Well-prepared people cover ground fast because they are prepared, enthusiasm makes people talk quickly, and some disputes genuinely contain many separate valid points. Volume is not the signal; whether individual claims survive a proper look is.

codex_fields.name: Limited Hangout
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target closes the matter believing they now have the full picture, and the smaller admission is afterwards used as proof that there was nothing further to tell.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: People often disclose in stages as they find the nerve, or genuinely do not yet know the full scope of what they did; leading with the largest thing and filling in details later is a natural order, not a suspicious one. What is described here is a small admission used to foreclose the question.

codex_fields.name: Pseudo-Profundity / Intellectual Intimidation
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target is left unable to challenge a conclusion they never understood, and reads their own confusion as a shortfall in themselves rather than in the explanation.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Some subjects genuinely need specialist vocabulary, and real experts are frequently poor at translating what they know into plain language. Asking for it in simpler terms usually separates them: genuine expertise can be restated, hollow language cannot.

codex_fields.name: Semantic Erosion / Meaning Dilution
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target loses the accurate word for their own situation, so describing it plainly now sounds like exaggeration — to other people and often to them.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Words drift for ordinary cultural reasons all the time, loosened by thousands of unconnected people using them casually, and there is legitimate good-faith argument about where a concept's edges lie. This describes dilution that happens to relieve one particular person of an accusation.
codex_fields.note: Hard to distinguish from ordinary language change without attributing intent, so the disconfirming case leans on who benefits rather than on what was meant.

codex_fields.name: Dog Whistling / Coded Signaling
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target reacts to something real that nobody else in the room can see, so their reaction becomes the visible event while the message itself stays deniable.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Private references and inside jokes are ordinary and usually harmless, and a phrase can land on something painful entirely by accident. Because the meaning is by design invisible to observers, this is one to hold especially loosely: no onlooker, and no tool, can confirm it from the words alone.
codex_fields.note: The tactic is defined by deniability, so the disconfirming case doubles as a caution that it is close to unverifiable from text.

codex_fields.name: Information Cascades
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target is judged on a belief that nobody actually checked, and correcting it means taking on a whole group's social pressure rather than a single person's claim.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Widely held beliefs are often simply correct, and relying on a source with a real track record instead of re-verifying everything yourself is sensible rather than herd-like. The marker is people citing each other's agreement in place of anything independent.

codex_fields.name: Interruption Patterns
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target's points never reach completion, so their contribution is judged on fragments — and in time they start shortening themselves before anyone has cut in.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Some groups are interruption-heavy as a matter of culture and cut across everybody equally, and a single eager interruption means nothing at all. The question is distribution: spread across the room, or concentrated on the same voices.

codex_fields.name: Idea Theft in Real Time
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target's contribution counts for somebody else, and the only way to claim it back makes them look petty in the very moment it happens.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: People genuinely reach the same idea within minutes of each other, someone who did not register your version may honestly believe theirs is new, and a restatement that adds something substantive has earned its own credit. Once is coincidence; it is the repetition that registers.

codex_fields.name: Gatekeeping
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target needs permission that others do not, and because the criteria move there is no version of asking correctly that reliably works.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Managing access is the actual job in plenty of roles, and criteria that are published and applied to everyone are simply process; someone slow to make an introduction is usually just busy. The signal is criteria that change depending on who is asking.

codex_fields.name: Punishment by Proxy
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target's own boundaries start carrying a cost for someone else, so protecting themselves means exposing a person they care about — which is usually enough to stop them.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Timing coincides far more often than intuition expects, and third parties have their own independent history with the same people. This is among the easiest patterns in the book to over-read and the least safe to act on from timing alone.
codex_fields.note: Kept the disconfirming case deliberately strong because the tactic is defined by an inference about causation that the reader usually cannot verify.

codex_fields.name: Weaponized Inclusion / Strategic Containment
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target's independent options close as their formal ones open, and any objection is answered by the fact that they were included.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Genuine inclusion in which someone's input really does move outcomes looks much the same from outside, and new structures often take time to build the mechanisms that make input count. Having less influence because of seniority or experience is not containment.

codex_fields.name: Controlled Opposition
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target's dissent is absorbed rather than answered: effort goes into a channel that was not built to lead anywhere, and the appearance of a debate substitutes for a change.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Movements disagree internally about strategy constantly, and a critic who is cautious by genuine conviction is not a plant. Overlap between someone's positions and the interests they criticise is common and usually coincidental — this needs evidence of actual coordination, not a feeling that the opposition is too tidy.
codex_fields.note: Politically loaded and highly prone to conspiratorial over-reading; the disconfirming case is written to raise the evidence bar rather than describe an innocent lookalike.

codex_fields.name: Reputation Laundering
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target has to argue against a portrayal with no traceable origin, while each person repeating it treats everyone else's repetition as their evidence for it.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Reputations are frequently earned, and "everyone says that" is sometimes simply true. Several people who had similar experiences at first hand are corroborating each other; the distinction worth drawing is between people who encountered the person and people who encountered the story.

codex_fields.name: Maternal Gatekeeping
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The corrected caregiver's confidence erodes until they step back, and the stepping back is then read as proof they were never really willing.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: One specific safety concern, raised constructively, is not this — and two caregivers can have genuinely different methods that both work perfectly well. Someone still learning a particular skill can be given proportionate guidance without their competence being the target of it.

codex_fields.name: Echo Chamber Construction
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target loses the outside views that would let them sense-check their own situation, and the narrowing arrives feeling like a preference they chose.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: People form affinity groups on their own, and recommending sources you honestly rate is not curating somebody else's world. The distinguishing feature is active discouragement of everything else, not enthusiasm for something in particular.

codex_fields.name: Stochastic Harassment Direction
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target absorbs harassment from many people at once while the portrayal that produced it stays technically deniable, so there is no single act to report and no one to hold to it.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Proportionate public criticism of someone's public actions is legitimate even when a third party overreacts to it, and reporting real wrongdoing through appropriate channels is not incitement. What is described here is repeated inflammatory portrayal aimed at an audience, not criticism as such.
codex_fields.note: Turns on foreseeability, which is a judgement about likely effect rather than a described behaviour, so the disconfirming case does most of the guarding.

codex_fields.name: Information Laundering
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The target is contradicted by something that now looks well-sourced, and disproving it means unpicking a chain of citations rather than a single claim.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Responsible journalism legitimately cites and builds on other credible reporting, and a claim that several outlets each confirmed separately is corroborated rather than laundered. The thing to trace is whether any link in the chain did original verification work.

codex_fields.name: Emotion Control
codex_fields.why_this_matters: When only some feelings are safe to show, a person stops reporting the rest and eventually stops noticing them; what remains of their emotional life is the part that was permitted.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Households and workplaces do have norms about how feelings get expressed, and cultures differ widely on this — a difference in emotional style is not a tactic. What matters is whether the norm falls evenly on everyone or lands on one person as a penalty for particular feelings.

codex_fields.name: Ritualized Exhaustion
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Depletion sustained over months narrows the capacity to think, weigh options and push back — and once that capacity is gone, noticing its absence gets harder too.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Genuinely hard stretches exist — a launch, a new baby, a family crisis — and a demanding period with a real, disclosed end point is not the same as an open-ended schedule that never gives any rest back.

codex_fields.name: Nonverbal Dominance
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Because nothing quotable is ever said, the experience cannot be evidenced to anyone else, and the person on the receiving end often ends up self-editing around a reaction they could not describe if asked.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Faces move on their own: a flash of visible irritation, an expressive manner, a real sigh at the end of a long day. Ask whether the reaction appears whenever something is annoying, or specifically whenever one person disagrees.

codex_fields.name: Postural Dominance
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Being physically talked down to registers below the level of argument; a sense of having shrunk arrives with nothing concrete to point at.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Rooms have layouts, people have different heights and builds, and someone standing up is usually just about to leave. What separates this from ordinary movement is positioning that recurs specifically around correction or disagreement.

codex_fields.name: Spatial Invasion
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The body reacts to a blocked exit well before there are words for it, so fear arrives in a conversation where nothing was ever threatened out loud.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Personal-space norms vary a great deal between cultures and between individuals, and small rooms, lifts and crowded venues force closeness on everyone in them. A closeness noticed and corrected once is not this.
codex_fields.note: Treated differing cultural norms about proximity as a first-line disconfirming case even though the entry carries no cultural flag, because the entry's own false-positive list raises it.

codex_fields.name: Resource Sabotage
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Failing without the tools needed to succeed reads to everyone watching — and often to the person themselves — as plain incompetence.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Budgets get cut, colleagues forget things, and money and attention are legitimately redirected for real, stated reasons. The question is whether the shortfall lands on everyone or only ever on one person, and whether the missing support is acknowledged when the work then fails.

codex_fields.name: "Managed Out" Through Exhaustion
codex_fields.why_this_matters: A departure produced by these conditions looks, on paper and in memory, like a free choice — which leaves the person carrying the story that they simply could not cope.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Restructures, shrinking budgets and genuine role mismatches all hollow out jobs, and an employer in real decline has less to offer everyone. A transparent change applied across a group is a different thing from a quiet, gradual removal aimed at one person while no complaint is ever filed.

codex_fields.name: Account Control
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Losing independent access to your own email, money or messages turns ordinary daily life into something that has to be requested.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Plenty of households share accounts by agreement, a parent reasonably manages a young child's, and forgotten passwords get reset together. The distinguishing feature is access changed without the account holder's knowledge and returned only on conditions.

codex_fields.name: Evidence Traps
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Knowing that anything said may be stored and re-timed makes ordinary candour feel risky; speech starts being drafted rather than spoken.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Keeping records is legitimate and often wise, and raising something someone said because it still matters, in the context it was said in, is just conversation. What is being described is the stripping of that context and the choosing of the moment it returns.

codex_fields.name: Moral Framing
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Once the subject has become what kind of person you are, the original issue is no longer on the table and cannot be settled.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Sometimes an observation about character is accurate, specific and offered as real feedback, and sometimes two people simply hold different values and read the same event through them. A hurt remark later walked back and replaced with substance is not this.

codex_fields.name: Reproductive Coercion
codex_fields.why_this_matters: A decision that belongs to one person's body and life ends up made under the weight of what refusal would cost them — job, money, support, standing in the family.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: People are allowed to want things and say so: a parent hoping for grandchildren, a partner describing the family they imagined. A neutral, lawful employment policy can also touch a reproductive decision without targeting it. What changes the picture is a consequence attached to the answer.

codex_fields.name: Negative Reinforcement Traps
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Relief becomes the reward for giving in, and in time the giving-in starts arriving early, before the pressure does — so the disagreement underneath is never actually discussed.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Moods rise and fall, tension genuinely eases when something is resolved, and some people are simply changeable without using it as leverage. Calm that follows a real conversation is different from calm that only ever arrives at the moment of compliance.

codex_fields.name: Moving-in-Silence
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Finding out after the fact that your life has been rearranged leaves nothing to discuss, only something to absorb.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Emergencies do force fast decisions, some areas are genuinely one person's agreed domain, and a surprise party is kept quiet for kind reasons. What distinguishes this is whether the exclusion is explained afterwards, and whether it happens only on the decisions that carry weight.

codex_fields.name: Smart-Home Coercion
codex_fields.why_this_matters: When the house itself becomes unpredictable, there is nowhere to be unobserved and nothing that can be shown to anyone else afterwards.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Connected devices misfire, updates change settings without asking, and households share systems by agreement — someone adjusting the heating to their own preference is not surveillance. Unexplained changes that cluster around moments of conflict are a different picture.

codex_fields.name: Health Sabotage
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Sleep, medication and medical care are the ground a person stands on to think and act; when those go, so does the capacity to notice what is happening or to leave.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: New babies, illness and crises wreck everyone's sleep and routines at once; transport, money and shift patterns genuinely get in the way of appointments; and someone struggling with their own health may be unable to help without doing anything to harm.

codex_fields.name: Choice Architecture Manipulation
codex_fields.why_this_matters: A choice that felt free but always led one way leaves nothing to object to afterwards — consent was given to something that was never really picked.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Arguing openly for one option, with the reasoning visible, is ordinary persuasion, and sensible defaults exist for practical reasons. The difference lies in whether the reasoning sits on the table or inside the way the options were described.

codex_fields.name: Blackmail / Leverage Exploitation
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Something shared in trust becomes the reason compliance is no longer optional, and the fear of exposure keeps working long after any particular demand has passed.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Expressing real hurt about a past disclosure is not this, nor is pursuing genuine wrongdoing through proper channels, and a furious remark retracted afterwards may be anger rather than a lever. The mark is a specific demand attached to the possibility of exposure.

codex_fields.name: Willful Blindness as Complicity
codex_fields.why_this_matters: When the person best placed to look declines to, harm carries on with nobody formally responsible for it, and the person being harmed has no route to anyone who will act.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Not knowing is usually just not knowing: information genuinely is not always available, and someone outside the chain of responsibility had no duty or opportunity to go looking. Someone who did look, acted, and got an unsatisfying result has not looked away.

codex_fields.name: Moral Outrage as Weapon
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Backing down to lower the temperature is not agreement, but it ends the conversation just as effectively — and questioning the intensity starts to feel like defending the thing being condemned.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Some things warrant real indignation, and people who care deeply about an issue sound intense without calculating it. Raising an ethical concern firmly and clearly is not the same as an intensity that grows each time its proportionality is questioned.

codex_fields.name: Ghosting as Control
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Without any account of what happened there is nothing to process; the questions stay open, and attention stays fixed on someone who has gone.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: People need space, some find every difficult conversation genuinely hard and avoid it badly, and relationships fade by mutual drift. Even a brief "I need distance" is information — the pattern here is silence that lifts precisely when the other person starts to move on.

codex_fields.name: Humiliation Rituals
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Being told the humiliation is the point makes objecting to it look like failing the test, so the cost is paid twice: once in public, and again in staying quiet about it.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Genuinely hard training and demanding standards push people without diminishing them, and one harsh moment inside an otherwise respectful process is friction rather than a rite. Ask whether the stated growth would survive removing the audience.

codex_fields.name: Public Exposure
codex_fields.why_this_matters: An audience makes the moment permanent: it is witnessed, retold, and cannot be taken back privately later.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Some things genuinely have to be addressed where they happen — a safety problem in a room full of people — and information can be public for a real, disclosed reason. Carelessness with something private is also not the same as choosing a setting for the size of its audience.

codex_fields.name: Forced Submission
codex_fields.why_this_matters: An apology given to end pressure still enters the record as an admission, and the person then has to live alongside having confessed to something they do not believe they did.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Asking for accountability where something actually happened is fair, and saying you were hurt and want it acknowledged is not forcing anything. What sets this apart is pressure that continues regardless of what the facts turn out to be.

codex_fields.name: Stalking & Surveillance (Post-Separation)
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Separation is supposed to end the other person's access; when it does not, ordinary life — where you live, who you see, what you do next — continues to be conducted under observation.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Shared custody and shared property require real, continuing contact, and news travels through mutual friends without anyone monitoring anyone. What falls outside that is knowledge of details that were never shared through any of those channels.
codex_fields.note: The entry's short definition is truncated in the source ("Comprehensive monitoring after the."), so both fields were derived from the expanded description and the examples rather than the definition line.

codex_fields.name: Legal Abuse (Post-Separation)
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Each filing looks procedurally normal on its own, so the cost accumulates in money, time and nerves without ever producing a single moment anyone would call abuse.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Complicated separations legitimately need many legal steps, courts are slow and expensive by themselves, and someone protecting a real interest will feel adversarial to the other side. Re-litigating settled matters with no new substantive basis is what stands apart.

codex_fields.name: Reputation Warfare (Post-Separation)
codex_fields.why_this_matters: An account seeded among the right people follows someone into work and friendships they thought were separate, and it is answered — if ever — long after it has been believed.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Venting honestly to a close friend after a painful breakup is not a campaign, shared contacts can reach their own conclusions from their own experience, and social circles simply thin out after a separation.

codex_fields.name: Edited Recordings
codex_fields.why_this_matters: A recording carries the authority of evidence, so the burden falls on the person in it to talk their way out of something that appears to show itself.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Clips get shortened for length and clarity constantly, and an excerpt honestly labelled as partial makes no claim to be the whole picture. Poor recording quality and natural gaps in a device's capture are not edits.

codex_fields.name: Account Takeover
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Being displaced from your own accounts means losing not only access but the ability to speak as yourself — messages can go out under your name to people with every reason to believe them.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Forgotten passwords and legitimate recovery processes exist, platforms have bugs and outages, and an authorised family member resetting a shared account and saying so is housekeeping. Recovery attempts being blocked or intercepted is what makes it something else.

codex_fields.name: SIM Swap / 2FA Interception
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The phone number that secures everything else becomes the way in, and the lockout usually arrives before there is any way to understand what has happened.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Carriers have outages, billing errors and genuine glitches, and a single odd authentication code on one platform means very little on its own. A carrier-account change nobody requested is the part without an innocent reading.

codex_fields.name: Intimate Image Abuse
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Control over the most private material about a person passes to somebody else, and the fear of exposure keeps working whether or not anything is ever actually shared.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Images shared consensually inside a relationship, with no threat and no sharing beyond it, are not this. A claim to hold such material when none exists is still coercion — worth distinguishing, because what to do about it differs.
codex_fields.note: Kept the entry's own distinction that a bluffed claim is still coercive, so the disconfirming case does not read as dismissal.

codex_fields.name: Algorithmic Manipulation
codex_fields.why_this_matters: What a person sees, and so what they take the world to be like, is shaped by a process they cannot inspect — and the beliefs that result feel entirely their own.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Ranked feeds are the default everywhere, and personalisation that surfaces more of what someone already reads is ordinary product design rather than a campaign. Nothing in a conversation can settle this either way; where it has been shown at all, it has been shown by researchers with access to the systems.

codex_fields.name: Dark Patterns (AI-Adaptive)
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Money, data and consent leave a person's hands through interfaces built so that the fastest, most default path is not the one they would have chosen with time to read.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Good design nudges too — a prominent save button, a sensible default — and a confusing checkout is far more often just badly built than built to work against the user. What is being described is an interface that gets harder to escape the more it learns about one particular user.

codex_fields.name: Synthetic Persona Networks
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Someone forms a view of what people think, or of who they are talking to, on the strength of accounts that no person stands behind.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Pseudonymous accounts, staff posting under a brand name, and a group of people who genuinely agree are not a fake network. Establishing coordination takes platform-level data, not a hunch about a stranger's profile picture.

codex_fields.name: Context Poisoning
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Decisions get made against a corrupted record, and because the corruption sits in the source, the person and the tools they check themselves against return the same wrong answer.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Shared information spaces fill with ordinary error, stale pages and honest disagreement without anyone injecting anything. Deliberate insertion is a claim that needs forensic evidence, not just the experience of finding something wrong on the internet.

codex_fields.name: Parasocial Manipulation Engineering
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The warmth is felt as mutual by one side only, and loyalty, money or personal information are given on the strength of a relationship that has no reciprocal half.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Creators, teachers and public figures build real rapport with audiences, and one-sided attachment forms on its own without anyone cultivating it. Selling something to an audience is not the flag; simulated closeness that makes declining feel like a betrayal is.

codex_fields.name: Immersive Manipulation (VR/AR)
codex_fields.why_this_matters: An experience the body treats as real leaves something closer to a memory than an argument, and memories are much harder to revise afterwards.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Immersive media is used honestly for training, therapy, education and storytelling, and a simulation that moves someone deeply is doing what art does. The concern is a staged experience offered as evidence about how the world actually is.

codex_fields.name: AI-Driven Social Engineering (Automated)
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The usual defences — an unfamiliar voice, clumsy wording, an address that looks wrong — stop working when the approach is generated to sound exactly like someone already known and trusted.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Real organisations do phone, email and ask to verify identity, and synthetic voice is now standard in ordinary customer service lines. An unexpected contact proves nothing by itself; verifying through a channel you chose yourself is the sensible response either way.

codex_fields.name: Weaponized AI Empathy
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Disclosure comes easily to something that seems to understand, and what is disclosed is retained by a system rather than held by a person.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Warm, attentive design in an assistant is not deceit, and people take real comfort from these tools. The line sits at apparent care used to draw out information or compliance that would otherwise have been withheld.

codex_fields.name: Biometric Exploitation
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Signals nobody chooses to send — a face, a voice under strain, a pulse — become the basis on which the next thing said to that person is selected.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Health trackers, accessibility tools and consented research all read physiological data for the benefit of the person providing it. Disclosure and consent are what separate them, not the sensing itself.

codex_fields.name: Epistemic Coercion via AI
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Confidence in one's own reasoning erodes when every question is answered fluently by something that never sounds unsure, and the habit of checking elsewhere quietly lapses.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: A tool that is genuinely useful and usually right will be relied on, and leaning on a good source is not dependence. Worth distinguishing: a system that shows its reasoning and its uncertainty, versus one whose framing is the only one ever on offer.

codex_fields.name: AI-Driven Narrative Hijacking
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Sheer volume settles what a topic is about before most people have finished forming a view, so the terms of the argument arrive already fixed.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Coordinated campaigning is normal politics, and popular ideas spread fast on their own — virality is not evidence of synthesis. Volume alone says nothing about where something came from.

codex_fields.name: Algorithmic Targeting of Vulnerable Populations
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The approach arrives exactly when a person is least equipped to weigh it — short of money, newly bereaved, isolated — which is precisely why it works.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Relevant advertising is not automatically predatory, and outreach genuinely aimed at people in difficulty, such as a debt charity or a crisis line, is targeting of an entirely different kind. It is the terms of what is offered, not the fact of being reached, that makes it exploitation.

codex_fields.name: Pig Butchering (Long-Con Digital Fraud)
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Months of unhurried, ordinary relationship-building mean that when the request finally comes it arrives from someone the person has real reason to trust, and the losses are often life-changing.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Genuine friendships and relationships do begin online and build slowly, and someone talking enthusiastically about their own investments may simply be doing that. The turn worth noticing is a relationship that has asked for nothing beginning to direct money towards a platform it introduced.

codex_fields.name: Overton Window Manipulation
codex_fields.why_this_matters: What counts as an ordinary opinion shifts underneath people, so positions they would once have rejected outright arrive already sounding moderate.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Public opinion moves on its own and always has, and arguing for a position most people currently reject is how every reform has started. A single extreme statement is not a repositioning campaign — this describes drift visible only in aggregate and in hindsight.

codex_fields.name: Manufactured Consent
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Agreement reached from a curated picture is still experienced as one's own conclusion, which leaves nothing obvious to object to.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Governments and institutions explain their decisions, editors choose what to cover, and framing is unavoidable in any account of anything. Showing this requires systematic analysis of coverage over time, not disagreement with a particular story.

codex_fields.name: Astroturfing
codex_fields.why_this_matters: A view carries more weight when it looks like many ordinary people hold it, so a manufactured chorus crowds out the real one — and genuine grassroots voices then get doubted too.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Real grassroots movements are often coordinated, funded and professionally supported; organisation is not fakery. What is described here is participants who do not exist, or who are paid to appear as unaffiliated members of the public.
codex_fields.note: The entry's definition is truncated in the source ("...public support to."), so the fields rest on the standard sense of the term rather than the entry's own stated purpose clause.

codex_fields.name: Wedge Issue Exploitation
codex_fields.why_this_matters: People end up divided along a line drawn for someone else's benefit, arguing about who they are while the things they actually share go unaddressed.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Divisive issues are frequently important and deserve real argument, and raising one is not evidence of strategy. The distinction is between an issue pursued in order to settle it and one kept warm because the division itself is useful.

codex_fields.name: Computational Propaganda
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The sense of what most people believe — which shapes what any individual feels able to say aloud — gets set by accounts that are not people.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Parties, campaigns and advocacy groups legitimately coordinate their messaging, and scheduling tools and staff accounts are not bots. Attribution here is technical work; an account that argues aggressively is not evidence of a network.

codex_fields.name: Reflexive Control
codex_fields.why_this_matters: A decision reached through one's own careful reasoning is trusted far more than one taken under pressure, which is exactly what makes a decision built on selected inputs so hard to revisit later.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Everyone decides on incomplete information, and negotiators, advertisers and friends all present the facts that favour their case. This describes a sustained effort to shape another party's whole information picture, not the ordinary selectivity of anyone making an argument.

codex_fields.name: Normative Messaging
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Behaviour shifts to match what everyone else is said to be doing, even where private preference points elsewhere — and the claim about what everyone does is rarely checked.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Accurate social-norms messaging is a mainstream and often benign public-health tool, and it is not manipulation when the norm stated is true and the purpose is disclosed. An unverifiable or false claim about what everyone else does is the part to notice.

codex_fields.name: False Flag Operations
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Retaliation, suspicion and public anger land on a group that did not do the thing, and the record that would correct it is the very thing that was arranged.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: This is one of the most over-claimed ideas in circulation: most disputed events are genuinely confusing in their first days, and unanswered questions after an incident are normal rather than proof of staging. The documented cases were established through archives and investigation years afterwards, never through pattern-spotting in real time.
codex_fields.note: Leaned the disconfirming case towards warning against over-diagnosis, since this term is far more often misapplied than correctly applied.

codex_fields.name: Post-Truth Epistemic Manipulation
codex_fields.why_this_matters: When nothing can be known, nothing can be checked — and someone left doubting everything has no ground from which to object to anything.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Distrust of institutions is often earned, and acknowledging uncertainty or bias in reporting is intellectual honesty rather than corrosion. The difference lies between doubting a particular claim and abandoning the idea that claims can be tested at all.

codex_fields.name: Honey Trapping
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The relationship itself was the mechanism, so finding out means losing the connection and facing the consequences of everything disclosed inside it at the same moment.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Relationships involving people in sensitive positions are overwhelmingly just relationships, and suspicion about a partner's motives is not evidence of an operation. Attraction and professional proximity coincide constantly without anything being arranged.

codex_fields.name: Agent of Influence Operations
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Audiences weigh an argument partly by how independent its source appears; where that independence is not real, their judgement is being borrowed rather than informed.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Journalists, academics and executives take funding, briefings, access and hospitality openly, and holding a view that happens to suit a government or a company is not proof of recruitment. Undisclosed direction is the claim, and it takes documentary evidence to support.

codex_fields.name: Strategic Deception (Denial & Deception / D&D)
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Plans get laid against a picture of the world that was arranged to be believed, and the error usually becomes visible only once acting on it can no longer be undone.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Ordinary secrecy is legitimate — institutions and states keep capabilities and intentions confidential without staging a coordinated illusion. Not being told something is not the same as being actively pointed the wrong way.

codex_fields.name: MICE Framework Exploitation
codex_fields.why_this_matters: What gets used is whatever a person most needs or most fears losing — money worries, a sincere belief, a private embarrassment, a wish to be recognised — so the approach feels less like pressure and more like finally being understood.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: This is a framework analysts use to describe recruitment after the fact, not a checklist of warning signs. Everyone has financial pressures, convictions, embarrassments and vanity; having them is the human condition, not an indication that anyone is working on you.
codex_fields.note: Wrote the disconfirming case against reading the four vectors as personal red flags, since the entry is descriptive of recruitment analysis rather than of a detectable pattern.

codex_fields.name: PSYOP Message Framing
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Messages built around futility or inevitability leave people experiencing their own resignation as simple realism.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: The techniques described overlap heavily with ordinary advertising, campaigning and public communication, so spotting the shape of a frame tells you nothing about who wrote it or why. A rousing or a fatalistic message is not by itself an operation.

codex_fields.name: Strategic Leaking
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Information arrives with the credibility of something that escaped when it was in fact released, so a placed story is read as an exposed one.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Genuine whistleblowing and unauthorised disclosure in the public interest look identical from outside and are not this, and officials brief journalists routinely and openly. What is described is a release presented as unauthorised while serving whoever released it.

codex_fields.name: Cognitive Warfare
codex_fields.why_this_matters: What is attacked is a population's capacity to reason together, so the damage shows up as exhaustion, mutual distrust, and an inability to agree on anything for long enough to act on it.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Societies argue, polarise and lose trust for their own internal reasons — economic strain, real grievances, plain bad government — none of which requires an outside campaign. Attributing domestic dysfunction to a foreign adversary is itself a familiar and convenient move.
codex_fields.note: The entry's definition is truncated in the source ("...form consensus, or make."), so the fields were derived from the surviving clause about degrading critical thinking and consensus.

codex_fields.name: Cyber Manipulation Operations (CMOs)
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Nothing appears stolen and nothing appears broken, so decisions carry on being made confidently on figures that are quietly wrong.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Data corrupts through bugs, botched migrations and human error far more often than through intrusion, and a discrepancy in a system is a reason to investigate rather than a conclusion. This is a forensic finding, not something to infer from a number that looks off.

codex_fields.name: Adversarial Machine Learning
codex_fields.why_this_matters: The systems people are told to rely on — filters, fraud checks, screening tools — return confident answers shaped by someone else, and the person affected has no way to see why.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Models fail in ordinary ways too: they break on unusual inputs, carry the biases of their training data, and drift as the world changes. A wrong or strange output is far more likely to be a limitation than an attack.

codex_fields.name: Milieu Control
codex_fields.why_this_matters: With reading, contact and conversation all bounded by the group, there is no outside view left to compare anything against — including the question of whether the boundary itself is reasonable.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Communities of every kind have shared practices, retreats and periods of deliberate focus, and choosing to spend most of your time among people who share your commitments is ordinary. The question is whether outside contact and information can be resumed without penalty.

codex_fields.name: Mystical Manipulation
codex_fields.why_this_matters: An experience read as evidence of something greater is very hard to reconsider later, and the authority it lends to whoever presided over it is correspondingly hard to question.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Religious and spiritual experience is real to those who have it, and this entry takes no view on any belief. Ritual, atmosphere and preparation are ordinary parts of worship — the distinction being drawn is between a prepared setting and an event presented as spontaneous when it was arranged.
codex_fields.note: Made explicit that the entry is not adjudicating the truth of any religious belief, only the staging of events described as spontaneous.

codex_fields.name: Demand for Purity
codex_fields.why_this_matters: A standard nobody can meet keeps a person permanently slightly in the wrong, and the only place to seek relief from that is the authority that set the standard.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Many traditions and ethical communities hold demanding standards sincerely, and wanting to be better than you currently are is not shame-based control. What changes the picture is a standard drawn so that falling short is guaranteed and only the group can absolve it.

codex_fields.name: Sacred Science
codex_fields.why_this_matters: Doubt gets recoded as a fault in the doubter rather than a question about the claim, so the ordinary means of testing an idea are unavailable from inside.
codex_fields.what_it_is_not: Strong conviction is not this, and every field has foundational assumptions it does not reopen daily. The flag is a body of ideas that cannot be questioned without the questioner's character or loyalty becoming the subject instead.
